description: This file defines classes for handling system upgrade commands in a kickstart configuration, including support for different versions and deprecation notices.

classes.name: FC3_Upgrade
classes.description: Handles upgrade commands for Fedora Core 3, including parsing and string representation.

classes.name: F11_Upgrade
classes.description: Extends FC3_Upgrade to support root device specification for Fedora 11 upgrades.

classes.name: F20_Upgrade
classes.description: Deprecated upgrade command class for Fedora 20, indicating upgrades are no longer supported.

classes.name: F29_Upgrade
classes.description: Removes support for upgrade commands in Fedora 29, inheriting from F20_Upgrade.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the upgrade command classes with optional parameters.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns string representation of the command, including upgrade or install status.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates and returns an argument parser for the command.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to set class attributes.
